measured_decisions.decision: resource_limit maps to CheckResult status 'failed' with the reason still prefixed 'resource_limit:'
measured_decisions.reason: The schema status enum has no resource_limit member; it is a runtime reason taxonomy (REASON.RESOURCE_LIMIT), matching how the T11 coordinator terminalizes over-limit checks (status failed, reason resource_limit).

measured_decisions.decision: pdf.js getViewport({scale:1}) is validated against R*C per page (viewportVerified) rather than assumed
measured_decisions.reason: The contract requires retaining pdf.js' actual transform while anchoring overlays only on verified agreement; a mismatch is recorded in page/raster limitations and disables precise overlays instead of being silently repaired.

measured_decisions.decision: The pinned pair is served in-test from the frozen bun.lock install (apps/web/node_modules/pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/), with sha256 recorded in commands.log
measured_decisions.reason: T02 staged the runtime DATA assets under apps/web/public/assets/pdfjs/6.3.289/ (cmaps, standard_fonts, wasm, iccs, LICENSE) — no public copy of pdf.mjs/pdf.worker.mjs exists; the pinned package files are the same-origin pair the app will wire in a later task. The adapter itself stays injection-based and never resolves a version.

measured_decisions.decision: renderPage is exercised directly for the in-flight RenderTask.cancel + canvas-release proof, and through extract() for the adapter-level cancel
measured_decisions.reason: extract() short-circuits on a pre-aborted signal before creating a RenderTask; the direct renderPage call with an already-aborted signal still creates then cancels a REAL RenderTask deterministically (no timing races), and the canvas spy asserts 0x0 release.

review_attention: text.ts itemQuadCanonical(): the estimated extent uses item.transform axes + width/ax + style ascent/descent; vertical fonts get an added limitation. Confirm the em-ratio treatment reads as intended.
adapter.ts plan(): unavailable capabilities bind to the text reader id so they always answer unsupported from this adapter; confirm that is the intended binding rule vs dropping them.

F10/F11: task contract names them but T05 generated no such PDFs; the suite asserts absence + covers the identity substitute. A proposal doc was not written since this is an upstream fixture-coverage gap, not a contract conflict — flag for coordinator if a docs/proposals/T09.md is preferred.
limitations: F10/F11 fixtures absent from the T05 tree (asserted absent; identity mechanism covered via occurrenceId ordinal test; nothing fabricated).
media_box/crop_box always null via this API; effective view only.
Estimated TextItem extent only — no glyph-paint, per-character, visibility, render-mode or paint-overlap provenance.
Raster caps clamp large pages with recorded actual scale (userunit-10 exercises this).
attribution: No third-party material beyond the pinned pdfjs-dist@6.3.289 build consumed as a dependency (Apache-2.0; T02-staged LICENSE retained under apps/web/public/assets/pdfjs/6.3.289/LICENSE). No docs/ATTRIBUTION.md entry required by this task.
